visualCharacteristics: Horizontal, swipable product-can selector showing several cans at once, with circular prev/next navigation arrows overlaid on the sides. Slides snap-scroll horizontally.
contentPattern: One row per product slide. Each slide's first cell holds the product-can image (linked to its detail); an optional second cell holds label/content.
usage: Product-can selector on the 7up products page (and the homepage product explorer). Six flavour cans.
